title: Opt in to Claude observations
scenario: Scenario: native-observation / workflow-map. Candidate based on doctor parent 7131b4b, captured 2026-10-18. Python 3.11+, Git and Claude are required. Start with disposable settings; native model verification requires authorized provider access. Default installations collect nothing.

steps.title: Find the collection boundary
steps.instruction: Open docs/map/workflow.html. Under Anytime, open Self-improvement and eval, then 1. Observe. Expand the details and follow Sources to the store and native collection guide.
steps.caption: Actual local map dialog: Claude opt-in is available; Codex collection and comparative eval remain planned.
steps.expected: Use account/observation/native.md for the authoritative commands. A grant selects one exact project; the installer selects one Claude registration per account.

steps.title: Register, verify and revoke
steps.instruction: Create a grant with observations.py grant --client claude --project PATH and an explicit --home. Preview install or update with --observation-registration ID, then apply the reviewed plan. Start a fresh authorized session and inspect events. To stop, revoke the grant; use update --observation-registration none to remove delivery.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered selected results from an actual disposable Claude/Haiku 5.5 run; not a terminal screenshot.
steps.expected: Check native records and planning recovery independently. The hook process directory and payload cwd must both match the exact granted root; subdirectory or worktree drift fails closed. Prompts, arguments, file contents and transcript paths must be absent. This run also verified that a fresh native session after revocation added no records; it does not prove complete coverage or comparative improvement.
